nodes.description: Ownable._owner: private address holding the nominal owner; written in the Ownable constructor, renounceOwnership and transferOwnership.
Ownable.newComer: address initialised once at deployment to _msgSender() and used by the onlyOwner modifier instead of _owner.
_balances: mapping(address => uint256) storing token balances; minted in constructor and mutated in _transfer.
_allowances: nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing spend approvals; mutated in _approve and read in allowance/transferFrom.
_tTotal: constant total supply 100 * 10**12 * 10**18 assigned at declaration and returned by totalSupply().
_name (' Jolteon Inu  '), _symbol ('JINU ') and _decimals (18) token metadata state variables.
JolteonInu constructor: reads _msgSender(), stores _tTotal in _balances and emits Transfer(address(0), sender, _tTotal).
Context._msgSender() internal view virtual returning msg.sender; the single entry point of caller-controlled data.
onlyOwner modifier: require(newComer == _msgSender(), 'Ownable: caller is not the owner').
owner() public view returning _owner.
renounceOwnership() public virtual onlyOwner: sets _owner to address(0) and emits OwnershipTransferred.
transferOwnership(address) private onlyOwner: validates newOwner != address(0) and writes _owner = newOwner; private so ownership can never be transferred externally.
approve(address,uint256) public: forwards _msgSender(), spender and amount to _approve and returns true.
_approve(address ol, address tt, uint256 amount) private: zeroes the caller's allowance when ol != owner(), otherwise stores amount; emits Approval.
transfer(address,uint256) public: calls _transfer(_msgSender(), recipient, amount) and returns true.
transferFrom(address,address,uint256) public: calls _transfer then _approve to decrement the allowance read straight from _allowances.
_transfer(address,address,uint256) internal: SafeMath sub/add on _balances for sender and recipient, then emits Transfer.
balanceOf(address) public view returning _balances[account].
allowance(address,address) public view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
totalSupply() public view returning the immutable _tTotal.
name(), symbol() and decimals() public view getters returning the metadata state variables.
Address.sendValue(address payable,uint256) internal: balance check then recipient.call{value:amount}('') low-level value transfer.
Address._functionCallWithValue(address,bytes,uint256,string) private: isContract check then target.call{value:weiValue}(data) with arbitrary calldata.
msg.sender: the externally controlled caller identity returned by _msgSender() and consumed by approve, transfer, transferFrom, the constructor and onlyOwner.
Hidden allowance reset in _approve: if ol != owner() the stored allowance is force-overwritten to 0 while an Approval event with value 4 is emitted.
Low-level .call forwarding ether and/or arbitrary calldata to a caller-supplied target with no reentrancy guard and no state update ordering protection.
Privilege gate keyed to newComer (frozen at deployment) rather than _owner; because transferOwnership is private the effective controller can never be changed even though _owner can.
approve(address spender, ...) parameter: the address granted the allowance.
approve(..., uint256 amount) parameter: the allowance value requested by the caller.
transfer(address recipient, ...) parameter: destination of the token transfer.
transfer(..., uint256 amount) parameter: amount of tokens moved.
transferFrom(address sender, ...) parameter: account whose allowance is spent.
transferFrom(..., address recipient, ...) parameter: destination of the tokens.
transferFrom(..., uint256 amount) parameter: amount deducted from allowance and balance.
_transfer(address sender, ...) parameter: balance debited.
_transfer(..., address recipient, ...) parameter: balance credited.
_transfer(..., uint256 amount) parameter: value passed to SafeMath sub/add.
_approve(address ol, ...) parameter: allowance owner; compared against owner() to decide the reset branch.
_approve(..., address tt, ...) parameter: spender whose allowance mapping slot is written.
_approve(..., uint256 amount) parameter: value written to _allowances only when ol == owner().
transferOwnership(address newOwner) parameter: candidate owner, only checked non-zero.
allowance(address owner, ...) parameter used as the outer mapping key.
allowance(..., address spender) parameter used as the inner mapping key.
balanceOf(address account) parameter used as the _balances lookup key.
Local address msgSender in the Ownable constructor holding the result of _msgSender() before it is written to _owner.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the untrusted value returned by Context._msgSender().
Constructor obtains the deployer address through _msgSender().
onlyOwner compares the caller supplied by _msgSender() against newComer.
approve passes _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
transfer passes _msgSender() as the sender.
transferFrom passes _msgSender() as spender and recipient.
Base Ownable constructor writes the deployer into _owner.
Ownable state initialiser stores _msgSender() into newComer, freezing the privilege gate at deployment.
Constructor mints the whole _tTotal supply to the deployer balance slot.
Externally controlled msg.sender directly determines whether onlyOwner passes.
onlyOwner delegates the privileged gate to the immutable newComer check.
onlyOwner guards renounceOwnership.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership.
transferOwnership changes _owner but never newComer, so the real gate is untouched.
renounceOwnership zeroes _owner while newComer still controls onlyOwner.
transferOwnership assigns newOwner into _owner.
newOwner parameter flows into the zero-address check and the _owner write.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
approve delegates all work to _approve.
spender parameter is forwarded from approve to _approve.
amount parameter is forwarded from approve to _approve.
spender reaches _approve as the tt argument.
amount reaches _approve as the stored allowance value.
_approve writes the _allowances nested mapping.
_approve reads owner() (backed by _owner) to choose its branch.
When ol != owner() _approve silently forces the allowance to zero.
The hidden reset branch overwrites _allowances[ol][tt] with 0 and emits a misleading Approval event.
ol parameter is the mapping owner key used by _approve.
tt parameter is the spender key used by _approve.
amount parameter is conditionally written to storage by _approve.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer before updating the allowance.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrement the spender allowance.
sender parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
amount parameter flows into _transfer and the SafeMath sub on the allowance.
transferFrom reads _allowances[sender][_msgSender()] directly for the subtraction.
_transfer debits and credits the _balances mapping.
sender parameter selects the balance slot that is reduced.
recipient parameter selects the balance slot that is increased.
amount parameter is consumed by SafeMath sub/add on balances.
balanceOf reads _balances[account].
account parameter is the lookup key for the balance.
allowance reads the _allowances nested mapping.
owner parameter keys the outer allowance mapping.
spender parameter keys the inner allowance mapping.
totalSupply returns the _tTotal state variable.
name/symbol/decimals getters return the metadata state variables.
sendValue performs an external .call with value to an untrusted recipient, enabling reentrant execution.
_functionCallWithValue performs an external .call with arbitrary calldata and value to an untrusted target.
The owner gate reads the frozen newComer state variable as its authority source.
onlyOwner reads newComer on every privileged call.

amount is only meaningful as the argument of the approve entry point.
recipient is only meaningful as the argument of the transfer entry point.
amount is only meaningful as the argument of the transfer entry point.
sender is only meaningful as the argument of the transferFrom entry point.
recipient is only meaningful as the argument of the transferFrom entry point.

sender is the debited account argument of the internal _transfer routine.
recipient is the credited account argument of the internal _transfer routine.
amount is the value argument of the internal _transfer routine.
ol is the allowance owner argument whose comparison with owner() selects the behaviour of _approve.
tt is the spender argument written into the allowance mapping by _approve.
amount is the value argument conditionally stored by _approve.
newOwner is only used as the argument of transferOwnership.
owner is only used as the outer lookup key of the allowance view function.
spender is only used as the inner lookup key of the allowance view function.
account is only used as the lookup key of balanceOf.
the constructor local holds _msgSender() and is consumed immediately by the Ownable initialisation inside the deployment path.
